name: zep-context
description: Use Zep to get and save context about the user and the business for knowledge work in ChatGPT Work. Bundles a skill plus the Zep Context MCP Server.

interface.shortDescription: Context about the user and the business for knowledge work, backed by Zep.
interface.longDescription: Connect ChatGPT Work to your Zep context so it can search and, when allowed, add to your user graph — and use standalone graphs when your project enables them.
